name: Effective Range / Log Size
details: For every finite binary class, effective range is at least log size.
proof: All concepts agree outside their effective range. Restriction to the $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ active coordinates is therefore injective on $\mathcal H$, so $|\mathcal H|\leq2^{\mathrm E(\mathcal H)}$. Taking base-two logarithms yields $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\log_2|\mathcal H|$.
